verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp ships a server mode (`llama serve`, the 'Server' section, and a built-in web UI running against it), and GBNF grammars for constrained output. Together these suggest it could act as a local model backend. However, nothing in the pack documents an API format that coding agents can talk to, tool/function calling, or any actual agent integration. Missing for 10: documented OpenAI-compatible or similar agent-consumable API, tool-calling support, evidence of a coding agent connected and working, independent hands-on corroboration of agent backend use.
